description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galagedara, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420504
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazette).
